DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @JobCode VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @RootPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ArchiveFolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @LogFileName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ArchiveFileNamePrefix VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TempTidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ProcessMonths VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @OverrideProcessMonth VARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @ProcessJob VARCHAR(1)

SET @JobCode = @0
SET @TidalJobNumber = @1
SET @OverrideProcessMonth = @2

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @RootPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName)

--if dev and running from visualstudio (instead of tidal), then put D in front
IF @EnvironName = 'Dev' AND @TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%'
BEGIN
	SET @TempTidalJobNumber = (SELECT MAX(TidalJobNumber) FROM EPSDTJobFile WHERE TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%')
	SET @TidalJobNumber = 'D' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(@TempTidalJobNumber, 'D', '')) + 1, 1))))
END

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = @JobCode)
SET @FolderPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FolderPath')
SET @ArchiveFolderPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'ArchiveFolderPath')
SET @LogFileName = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'LogFileName')
SET @ArchiveFileNamePrefix = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'ArchiveFileNamePrefix')

SET @ArchiveFolderPath = REPLACE(@ArchiveFolderPath, '{&year}', CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), YEAR(GETDATE())))
SET @ArchiveFolderPath = REPLACE(@ArchiveFolderPath, '{&month}', RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(2), MONTH(GETDATE())), 2))
SET @ArchiveFileNamePrefix = REPLACE(@ArchiveFileNamePrefix, '{&tidalJobNumber}', @TidalJobNumber)
SET @LogFileName = REPLACE(@LogFileName, '{&tidalJobNumber}', @TidalJobNumber)
SET @ProcessMonths = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'ProcessMonths')
--if this state job is suppose to run this month, then let it
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM fnConvertListToStringTable(@ProcessMonths ,',') WHERE Item = MONTH(GETDATE()))
OR @OverrideProcessMonth = '1'
	SET @ProcessJob = '1' 
ELSE
	SET @ProcessJob = '0' 


SELECT
	JobId = @JobId,
	FolderPath = @RootPath + @FolderPath,
	FilePattern = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FilePattern'),
	XlsSheetName = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'XlsSheetName'),
	Delimiter = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'Delimiter'),
	XmlXsltFile = @RootPath + @FolderPath + (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'XmlXsltFile'),
	XmlRowTag = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'XmlRowTag'),
	ArchiveFolderPath = @RootPath + @FolderPath + @ArchiveFolderPath,
	ArchiveFileNamePrefix = @ArchiveFileNamePrefix,
	LogFileName = @RootPath + @FolderPath + @ArchiveFolderPath + @LogFileName,
	TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber,
	ProcessJob = @ProcessJob

DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @JobId = @JobId

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Start', 0, 0
EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Read Files', 0, 0

EXEC spExecuteSql 
@JobId=@JobId, 
@SqlKey='SqlImportJobInitialize'

DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)

SET @JobId = @JobId
SET @TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber

TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDTWellServicesInputLog 
TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDTWellServicesInput 
TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDTWellServicesRaw 

DELETE FROM EPSDTJobFile WHERE JobId = @JobId AND TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber

IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesInput]') AND name = N'IX_EPSDTWellServicesInput_JobId')
DROP INDEX [IX_EPSDTWellServicesInput_JobId] ON [dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesInput] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF )
GO

DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @PathFileName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ArchiveFileNamePrefix VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ArchiveFolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)

DECLARE @ArchivePathFileName VARCHAR(8000)

SET @JobId = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @TidalJobNumber = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @PathFileName = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @FolderPath = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @ArchiveFolderPath = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @ArchiveFileNamePrefix = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)

SET @ArchivePathFileName = @ArchiveFolderPath + @ArchiveFileNamePrefix + REPLACE(@PathFileName, @FolderPath, '')

--use archive file name, but move the file to the archive folder after process file
INSERT EPSDTJobFile(JobId, PathFileName, TidalJobNumber, CreateDateTime)
SELECT @JobId, @ArchivePathFileName, @TidalJobNumber, GETDATE()

SELECT 
	CONVERT(INT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS JobFileId,
	@ArchivePathFileName AS ArchivePathFileName

DECLARE @RawCount INT
DECLARE @RawInputCount INT
DECLARE @InputCount INT
DECLARE @LogCount INT
DECLARE @FileCount INT
DECLARE @Now DATETIME

DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @LogDesc VARCHAR(8000)

SET @JobId = @JobId
SET @TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber
SET @Now = GETDATE()

--get jobcounts and log it
SET @RawCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EPSDTWellServicesRaw WSR WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WSR.JobId = @JobId)
SET @RawInputCount = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(WellServicesRawId)) FROM EPSDTWellServicesInput WSI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WSI.JobId = @JobId)
SET @InputCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EPSDTWellServicesInput WSI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WSI.JobId = @JobId)
SET @LogCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EPSDTWellServicesInputLog WSIL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WSIL.JobId = @JobId)
SET @FileCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EPSDTJobFile JF WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE JF.JobId = @JobId AND JF.TidalJobNumber=@TidalJobNumber)

SET @LogDesc = 
	'TidalJobNumber=' + @TidalJobNumber +
	',RawCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@RawCount))) +
	',RawInputCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@RawInputCount))) +
	',InputCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@InputCount))) +
	',LogCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LogCount))) +
	',FileCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FileCount)))
	
EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobCount', @LogDesc, 0, 0

--get errorlogcounts and log it (dont break it down to logdesc for non-service-related errors)
INSERT INTO EPSDTAppLog ([Type], LogDateTime, JobId, LogDesc) 
SELECT 
	'JobLogCount',
	@Now,
	@JobId,
	LogDesc = 
		'TidalJobNumber=' + @TidalJobNumber +
		',Message=''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(WSIL.MessageId))) + '=' + M.MessageCode + '''' +
		',RowCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(*)))) 
FROM EPSDTWellServicesInputLog WSIL 
INNER JOIN EPSDTMessage M ON M.MessageId = WSIL.MessageId
WHERE WSIL.JobId = @JobId 
GROUP BY WSIL.MessageId, M.MessageCode
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

--get errorlogcounts and log it (break it down up to logdesc for service-related errors)
INSERT INTO EPSDTAppLog ([Type], LogDateTime, JobId, LogDesc) 
SELECT 
	'JobLogCount',
	@Now,
	@JobId,
	LogDesc = 
		'TidalJobNumber=' + @TidalJobNumber +
		',Message=''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(WSIL.MessageId))) + '=' + M.MessageCode + '''' +
		',LogDesc=''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(WSIL.LogDesc)) + '''' +
		',RowCount=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(*)))) 
FROM EPSDTWellServicesInputLog WSIL 
INNER JOIN EPSDTMessage M ON M.MessageId = WSIL.MessageId
WHERE WSIL.JobId = @JobId 
	AND WSIL.MessageId IN (22,5,20) --22=InvalidServiceCode,5=InvalidCPT,20=InvalidServiceDesc
GROUP BY WSIL.MessageId, WSIL.LogDesc, M.MessageCode
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Finish', 0, 0

EXEC spExecuteSql 
@JobId=@JobId, 
@SqlKey='SqlImportJobFinalize'
